generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.-NOT APPLICABLE

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The intending bidder should furnish the certificate of registration issued by state/ central Govt
The Tenderer should furnish the Name of the individual / firm/ Company with address and telephone number with place of registration, year of incorporation etc.
The Intending bidder are advised to visit the site of work and access the tender documents well in advance.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The tender processing fee will not be refunded
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public Procurement Portal.

The requisite Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) Through ONLINE only With validity from the date of opening of the tender. The tender schedule will be issued to the applicants who make payment through ONLINE only. Tenders received without valid EMD through e- payment will be rejected. Under this section of qualifying criteria the tenderer should furnish capacity details / format.

All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the bidders in a complete manner. Incomplete formats may constitute sufficient reason at the discretion of CNNL for rejection of the bid

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer will verify the original documents at any stage before recommending for approval. Bidders should produce their original documents for verification during office hours related to uploaded documents in e-portal within 3 days of opening of technical Bid

Further particulars, if any, required by the bidders can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, KRS Division, Krishnarajasagara, during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the calendar of any event mentioned above happen to be General Holiday / Declared holiday, the next working day will hold good for the respective events
Defect liability period is 15 days from the date of completion of the entire work, after issuing of work completion certificate from CNNL.
Tenderers shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka.
The tenderer should furnish the Name of the individual / firm/ Company with address and telephone number with place of registration, year of incorporation etc
The application made by the firm / company shall be signed by a person holding the power of attorney, in which case the Tenderer should furnish a copy of power of attorney shall be submitted

Necessary certificates should be signed by an officer not below the rank of the Executive Engineer or equivalent competent authority and should be countersigned by the superior officer not below the rank of Superintending Engineer or equivalent competent authority.

The intending Bidder/firm/company shall provide accurate information on the related form about any litigation or Arbitration resulting from contracts completed or on going under its execution over the last five years. The consisting history of awards against the tenderer may result in failure of the application.
Tenderer should furnish a copy of the Income Tax Return for the last five financial year (2021-22 to 2025-26)

The intending Bidder/firm/company shall provide the audited balance sheets or other financial statements acceptable to the employer for the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) and must demonstrate the current soundness of the applicants financial position and indicate its prospective long term profitability. If deemed necessary the employer shall have the authority to make enquiries with the applicants bankers.
The Tenderer should furnish a valid copy of GST Registration Certificate.
Employees provident fund registration certificate along with copy of recent paid challan is to be furnished.

Employees Provident fund Registration Certificate a)In respect of Contractors who are not registered with the EPF (Employees Provident Fund) authorities, the contractors should produce an undertaking that he shall within 7 days of the close of every month submit to the Executive Engineer, KRS Division, Krishnarajasagara, a statement showing the recoveries of contributions in respect of employees employed are through in and shall also furnish under the provision of the scheme to the commissioner, EPF b) However, having given an undertaking to this effect if the contractor does not furnish the information, the Nigama will deduct the necessary amount from the amount due from the contractor.Not withstanding the above, the contractor will be liable for any consequential penalty /damages levied by the EPF authorities.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before attending the pre- bid meeting and also before submitting the tenders.

Royalty Charges shall be recovered as per the prevailing rates by the Department of Mines and Geology & The Intending bidder should strictly follow the Department of Mines & Geology circular no. 11189-1121 Dated:26.02.2024.

The rates quoted by the contractor must be inclusive of all Taxes, etc., (including GST). The contractor is also required to pay quarry Fees, Royalties, Octroi Dues levied by the state Government or any Local body or an authority and ground rent, if any, charged by the Executive Engineer for stacking materials. No Extra Payment on this account will be made to the contractor.
GST will be deducted as per the prevailing Govt Orders from time to time in running bill
Increase in GST shall not be paid in extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

Materials like steel, cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the Contractor themselves and should get the same tested by the quality control authority of CNNL/ Karnataka Research station, if not by any NABL accredited labs before use in this work.

The work includes all lead and lift / delift and work shall be carried out as per instruction of engineer-in-charge of the work. And all the specification as per relevant Indian standard codes. The rate for the specifications in the Schedule-B includes all lead and lift, irrespective of distance and height.
Security Deposit Will be withheld till the expiry of the defect liability period.

Building and other construction workers welfare cess The contractor shall subscribe 1.00% of gross amount of each bill payable to him in respect of contract to the building and other construction workers welfare cess as per GO No: LD 300 LET 2006, Bangalore, dated: 18-01-2007. The amount of subscription will be recovered out of payable amount to him in each bill.This component is deemed to have been included in the quoted rate / Item rate.
The contractors should adhere to the accepted action plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work.
Sub leasing /subcontracting in any form is prohibited. Bids of bidders with track record of Subleasing/subcontracting are liable for rejection.

The quarries considered are for the estimate purpose only. The intending bidders shall visit the site, identify the quarries, ascertain availability for the quantity and quality of the materials required for the work and shall quote his rates accordingly. No extra claim whatsoever will be entertained in this regard.

On account of restrictions on sand mining and scarcity of availability of sand, as an alternative the use of manufactured sand (M-sand)confirming to relevant IS specifications may be allowed during the remodeling work

The rates includes all leads and lifts and work shall be carried out as per the instruction of Engineer-in-charge. All specifications are as per relevant IS codes in vogue and Indian Road Congress. The rates for the specification in the Schedule-B includes all lead and lifts irrespective of the distance and height, no extra claim will be entertained for additional lead and lifts.
The contractor should have capacity of deploying centralized batching plant along with The transit mixture during execution of concrete works for both structures and lining.
Successful Bidder should submit the PERT Chart at the time of Execution of Agreement.

Successful bidder should execute work agreement within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of acceptance, failing which his tender will be cancelled on Risk & Cost basis & his EMD will be forfeited
Related to qualification condition No :2, Idle charges for men & machineries for non- progress period delayed due to any reasons will not be paid.
As per FD GO dated 26.03.2019, NSIC exemption for EMD is not accepted.
CNNL reserves the right of rejecting all or any of the tenders without assigning any reasons.
Typo graphical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the contractor.
The undersigned reserves the right to either postpone or to cancel the entire process of tender.
Conditions as per bid document.

The bidder shall have adequate stock of major lighting and event materials/equipment required for execution of the work available in their own or legally hired/leased godown/warehouse. The bidder shall furnish the complete address and details of the godown/warehouse along with the Technical Bid.

The Tender Inviting Authority / Technical Evaluation Committee or its authorised officers may inspect the godown/warehouse and physically verify the availability, quantity, condition and operational readiness of the major materials/equipment before finalisation of the Technical Bid. The bidder shall produce the materials/equipment for physical verification and demonstrate their working condition wherever required.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing, hiring, arranging and installing stage and event infrastructure, German tents and exhibition structures, floating stage, thematic and floral decorations, furniture, branding and signages, sanitation, stage lighting and visual systems, bus facilities, barricading, mementos and honouring supplies, accommodation, green rooms, photography, videography and live streaming at Brindavan Garden, KRS, during Dasara Festival 2026.

itemList.description: Provide, erect and remove steel-framed timber stage and programme platforms, with bracing, ground supports and load-distributing bases suited to the installed deck height of 2 to 7 ft. Include continuous timber decking, carpet finish, secure edges, transport, erection labour and site clearance. Main deck, 100 x 50 ft, two religious platforms, 50 x 40 ft each, control and media platforms, 20 x 20 ft each, two camera platforms, 20 x 20 ft each,For 7 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide, erect and remove braced timber-on-steel stage stair and ramp units with secure fixings, non-slip walking surfaces, handrails and edge protection. Include four stair footprints of 30 x 8 ft and four ramp footprints of 20 x 8 ft, transport, labour and clearance. Distribute two of each at the main stage and one of each at each religious platform. Installed levels, rise/tread and access gradients shall follow the approved access drawing.For 7 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide, erect, maintain and dismantle thirty German pagoda tents, each 30 x 30 ft in plan, using an engineered demountable frame, weatherproof flame-retardant roof fabric, tensioning members, base plates, ballast/anchorage and rainwater shedding details. Include transportation, erection labour, perimeter finishing, routine inspection and site clearance. Keep access openings unobstructed.For 7 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide, erect, maintain and dismantle German pandals with engineered demountable frames, weatherproof flame-retardant roof fabric, bracing, tensioning, base plates, designed anchorage/ballast and rainwater drainage. Provide two exhibition structures of 300 x 40 ft and two dining structures of 100 x 100 ft. Include transportation, erection, maintenance, dismantling and site clearance.For 7 days. with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide, install, operate, maintain and remove a 50 ft x 80 ft modular floating stage over water on suitable certified pontoons/floating platforms, including structurally safe stage framing, marine-grade non-slip deck surface, proper load distribution, safe access gangway/ramp, side edge protection/railings wherever required, anchoring/mooring system to prevent movement, necessary bracing, leveling, erection, dismantling and removal after completion of the programme, complete with all labour, tools, tackles, transportation and safety arrangements,For 7 days. with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide a braced timber-on-steel raised access platform with carpet finish, safe transitions and edge protection where needed, installation height and supports to suit approved site arrangement.For 7 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Providing &Arranging on Hire basis good quality Green rooms comprissing of platform, table, carpet, chair, mirror etc.. inclusive of cost of all transportation, labour,clearing the site for the next event etc. For 7 days,complete as per specification as directed by the officer in charge of the work with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide and erect box-type welcome arches on hire, each with a 60 ft span and 24 ft high vertical supports. Use trussed framing supported on 6-inch diameter MS pipe columns, intermediate pipe purlins and 10 ft framing spacing as specified in the source quotation, form 4 ft wide clad pillars with plywood/flex and timber secondary framing. Provide internal cloth ceiling and pillar finish, secure structural joints, designed anchorage, transport, installation, maintenance and removal.For 11 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide an “I LOVE KRS” 3D logo cutout for Dasara 2026 fabricated in lightweight yet sturdy material (ACP on MS frame or foam-board with MS/Al frame), minimum 10-12 ft wide and 6-8 ft high, outdoor-grade UV-print/laminate with weatherproof finish. Ensure stable base with concealed ballast/anchoring, smooth edges, safe corners, and anti-tip design, rear bracing to resist wind loads. Install on a level, barricaded photo-spot with no-trip cable covers, keep fire extinguisher nearby, and provide cleaning and daily inspection.For 11 days, as per the directions of the Engineer In-Charge with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide a Yaali pillar photo-booth set comprising 2-4 FRP/EPS and FRP Yaali pillars flanking a themed backdrop, clear span 3-4 m and height 2.4-3 m, on a modular hot-dip galvanized MS frame with concealed base plates/ballast for wind loads. Finish in exterior-grade PU/2K paint with clear coat, rounded edges, and non-slip flooring, backdrop in ACP/ply or fabric with temple graphics/branding. Provide queue stanchions, displayed load limits, and a 6 kg ABC extinguisher. Vendor to supply transport, installation, daily cleaning/inspection, night security if outdoors, de-rigging, and submit GA sketch, materials/anchoring data, insurance, and compliance before start.For 11 days, all works shall be with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Providing & Erecting on Hire basis good quality Flag posts of height up to 20 ft made of M.S. Pipe of 2 inch dia duly painted and fixed to the ground firmly to a minimum depth of 1 ft6 inch including fixing the coloured satin cloth flag with dasara logo print of size 3 ft x 5 ft (appox.) including cost of flag on hair basis etc, inclusive of transportation, labour, clearing the site for the next event etc.For 11 days, complete as per specification as directed by the officer in charge of the work with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide fresh multi-colour floral decoration to measured stage-front portions and presentation borders at approved locations, using department-approved fresh flowers, foliage, fixing mesh, concealed ties and necessary supporting materials, installed neatly and securely without obstructing stage equipment, electrical fittings, movement areas or access routes. The arrangement shall be maintained in approved appearance throughout the programme, including renewal/replacement of wilted flowers and removal of spent flowers, waste material and fixing arrangements after completion, complete with labour, materials, transport and all incidental charges,For 7 days. with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Supplying and arranging on Hire basis good quality VIP/VVP Cushion Chairs inclusive of cost of all transportation, labour, clearing the site for the next event etc. complete as per specification,For 7 days,as directed by the officer in charge of the work with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Supplying and arranging on Hire basis good quality VIP/VVP Cushion Chairs inclusive of cost of all transportation, labour, clearing the site for the next event etc. complete as per specification,For 7 days,as directed by the officer in charge of the work with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Providing &Arranging on Hire basis good quality Three Seater Sofa inclusive of cost of all transportation, labour, clearing the site for the next event etc. complete as per specification,For 7 days, as directed by the officer in charge of the work with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Supplying and arranging on Hire basis good quality -Teapoys minimum size of 1.5 ft x 3 ft with cloth cover etc., complete. inclusive of cost of all transportation, labour, clearing the site for the next event etc. complete as per specification,For 7 days,with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Supplying and Arranging on Hire basis good quality plastic chairs without arm with cloth cover inclusive of cost of all transportation, labour, clearing the site for the next event etc. complete as per specification,For 7 days, as directed by the officer in charge of the work with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Supply, arrange, maintain and remove plastic chairs without arms for prasada dining, waiting areas and associated overflow arrangements, of good quality and suitable strength, cleaned and placed as directed at site, complete including loading, unloading, transportation, labour for arrangement/re-arrangement during the programme, replacement of damaged chairs if required, and removal after completion,For 7 days. with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Supplying and arranging on Hire basis good quality Tables of size 1 ft6 inch X 6 ft with all components like Cloth cover & frill etc., complete inclusive of cost of all transportation, labour, clearing the site for the next event etc. complete as per specification,For 7 days, as directed by the officer in charge of the work with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide 10 ft x 10 ft branding panels (fabrication and installation) using either rigid ACP/ply on MS frame or tension fabric SEG system, with UV/eco-solvent prints, non-glare laminate, and clean edge finishing. Frames in hot-dip galvanized MS/Al with concealed base plates/ballast, designed for wind loads if outdoors, overall depth 50-100 mm. Include neat joins, flush seams. Supply transport, installation, daily cleaning/inspection, de-rigging, and submit artwork proofs, color match (Pantone) For 7 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Providing and Supplying on Hire basis good quality Designing DTP works, erection of different type of fabric material boards digital printing on fabric material of cloth of different sizes including cost of wooden frame, fixing on wooden frame & erection at different locations with reqired poles etc., inclusive of cost of all transportation, labour, clearing the site for the next event etc. complete as per specification,For 11 days, as directed by the officer in charge of the work with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide, install, service and remove 100 self-contained cubicle chemical toilets with doors, privacy locks, ventilation, chemical holding tanks and associated washing arrangements. Include delivery, placement, clean water and cleaning consumables, daily cleaning and refreshing, periodic pumping and disposal through an authorised service, relocation within the allocated clusters where directed, and final removal and site cleaning.For 7 days,For 11 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Supplying and Arranging on Hire basis good quality Persian Carpet inclusive of cost of all transportation, labour, clearing the site for the next event etc. For 7 days,complete as per specification as directed by the officer in charge of the work with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Supplying and Arranging on Hire basis good quality Charms/Synthetic Carpet inclusive of cost of all transportation, labour, clearing the site for the next event etc. For 7 days,complete as per specification as directed by the officer in charge of the work with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Supply and lay synthetic carpet over the public audience seating and internal circulation area at the programme stage, excluding stage platforms and the separate VIP carpet.For 7 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Supply and lay Persian carpet in the stage VIP seating zone, excluding raised access and stage-platform areas whose rates include carpet.For 7 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide, erect, maintain and remove interlocking Mojo crowd-control barricade modules, each 1.0 m long, with stable footplates, secure pins/connections and a smooth crowd-facing surface. Include transport, placement to the marked runs, alignment, daily inspection and final clearance. Maintain agreed gates and rescue/service access openings.For 11 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide, erect, maintain and remove interlocking Mojo crowd-control barricade modules, each 1.0 m long, with stable footplates, secure pins/connections and a smooth crowd-facing surface. Include transport, placement to the marked runs, alignment, daily inspection and final clearance. Maintain agreed gates and rescue/service access openings.For 11 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide, erect, maintain and remove interlocking Mojo crowd-control barricade modules, each 1.0 m long, with stable footplates, secure pins/connections and a smooth crowd-facing surface. Include transport, placement to the marked runs, alignment, daily inspection and final clearance. Maintain agreed gates and rescue/service access openings.For 11 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Providing and erecting on hire basis good quality dustbins at approved locations, including supply, placement, regular shifting/re-arrangement if required, maintenance in usable condition, and removal after completion of the event, complete including all transportation, loading, unloading, labour charges, watch and ward for the contractor’s materials, clearing the site for the next event, and all incidental charges as per specification and,For 11 days, as directed by the Officer-in-charge of the work. with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Providing and hiring Free Bus Facilities through KSRTC for transportation of visitors from temporary parking to Brindavan Garden operated as per the route, timings and number of buses required, based on the directions of the Department and tourist inflow during the festival period. The arrangement shall include necessary bus hire charges and operational expenses as applicable to KSRTC, ensuring smooth and uninterrupted transportation of visitors back during Dasara Festival-2026. For 11 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Hire, install, test and remove twelve additional cordless microphone systems, each with handheld transmitter, compatible receiver, antenna/power accessories, batteries and connection leads. Coordinate usable frequencies, label and test each channel, and integrate with the separately supplied sound console.For 7 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide five physical podiums/lecterns with neat finish for stage programme use, including transport, arrangement and removal.For 7 days with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Hire, install, focus, operate and remove PAR 64 stage luminaires with suitable lamps, mounting clamps, safety bonds, local fixture cabling and control interface. Provide 100 working units for stage wash and performer key lighting, 60 at the main stage and 20 at each religious platform. Include functional testing, focusing, routine upkeep and replacement of failed lamps/units.For 7 days with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Hire, install, address, test, operate, maintain and remove stage strobe luminaires with suitable clamps, safety bonds, power and control leads, controllable flash intensity and flash rate, show-control integration, operator cue coordination, upkeep and necessary replacements during the programme, complete including all labour, tools, tackles, transportation and incidental charges, executed at approved stage/platform locations,For 7 days. with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Hire, erect and remove five 24 ft aluminium flying truss sections, complete with compatible connectors, certified lifting/rigging accessories, clamps and safety attachments. Provide three lighting bars for the main stage and one for each religious platform, with transport, erection crew, lifting operations and dismantling. Rig loads and suspension shall follow the approved rigging drawing.For 7 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Hire, erect and remove three motorized aluminium lighting-truss structures, each 72 ft long x 52 ft wide x 24 ft high. Use rectangular truss construction with 450 x 450 mm pillar sections and 560 x 760 mm beam sections, compatible connections, lifting motors, base plates, bracing and anchorage. Include transport, erection crew, load inspection, maintenance and dismantling.For 7 days with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Hire, install, operate and remove modular LED video walls, one main wall 40 x 10 ft and six relay walls 10 x 10 ft each. Include LED cabinets, power/data distribution within the screen, receiving/sending processors, panel support frames, rigging accessories, signal cabling, calibration, image mapping, daily maintenance and spare modules. Pixel pitch, brightness and refresh performance shall suit the viewing distance and camera use. The separate measured timber floor platforms are excluded from this screen-frame scope,For 7 days with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Hire, install and maintain eleven 55-inch LED-backlit information monitors at the separately marked sheltered visitor help points. Provide stable stands or secure mounts, playback devices, local leads, approved bilingual information loops, routine updates, weather protection, daily functional checks, transport and removal. Display visitor services, programme times, bus boarding and emergency information,For 11 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Hire, install, address, operate and remove 50 moving-head beam luminaires of the retained 7R/Sharpy type, with lamps/light sources, clamps, safety bonds, local power/control leads and DMX addressing. Provide 30 on the main-stage rig and 10 on each religious-platform rig. Include focusing, show-cue integration, functional testing, maintenance and failed-unit replacement.For 7 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge

Provide an experienced Visual Jockey for live shows to run synced visuals across main and delay LED walls, handling showfile preparation, content ingest/organization, live triggering, and sync via timecode/MIDI/OSC, with IMAG integration and emergency fallback playlists. The VJ should be proficient with Resolume/Arena, Notch, Hippotizer, or similar, manage EDID/refresh/latency and basic color workflows, and create audio-reactive/generative visuals with cue stacks and timelines. Supply suitable media servers with 4K-capable GPUs, SDI/HDMI capture, genlock as needed, a backup server with auto-failover, control surfaces, and UPS. Coordinate with FOH, lighting, audio, and broadcast teams, follow show cues, and maintain safe visual practices. Deliver a pre-show tech rehearsal, content cue sheet, signal diagram, daily logs, and handover of showfiles and media post-event,For 7 days, with all lead and all lifts and as directed by the engineer incharge
